What are your opening hours?
We're open Tuesday to Sunday, 11:30 AM to 10:00 PM. We're closed on Mondays for staff rest and kitchen prep.
Do you take reservations?
Yes! We recommend booking ahead, especially for weekend dinners. You can reserve a table through our website, by phone, or via OpenTable.
Is there parking available?
We have a small car park behind the restaurant with about 15 spaces and some street parking in the front, there's also a bus stop not too far away.
Do you offer vegetarian or vegan options?
Absolutely. Our menu includes several vegetarian dishes like aubergine parmigiana and mushroom risotto, and we can make many pasta dishes vegan upon request. Just let your server know.
Can you accommodate gluten-free diets?
Yes, we offer gluten-free pasta as a substitute in most dishes and have a dedicated gluten-free pizza crust. Please inform your server of any allergies so our kitchen can take extra care.
Do you have outdoor seating?
We have a lovely patio with about 8 tables, open seasonally from April through October, weather permitting.
Is the restaurant good for large groups or private events?
Definitely. We have a private dining room that seats up to 30 guests, perfect for celebrations, rehearsal dinners, or corporate events. Contact us for group menus and pricing.
Do you offer takeout or delivery?
Yes, takeaway orders can be placed by phone or through our website. We also partner with major delivery apps including UberEats and JustEat.
What's your most popular dish?
Our handmade tagliatelle al tartufo (truffle pasta) is a guest favorite, along with our wood-fired Margherita pizza and osso buco.
Do you have a kids' menu?
Yes, we offer a simple kids' menu with options like penne with butter, cheese pizza, and chicken fingers, all served with a side of fruit.
Do you have a full bar?
Yes, we offer a full bar featuring Italian wines, classic cocktails, and a curated selection of Italian aperitivi like Aperol Spritz and Negroni.
